regions.full_page: Many thanks for your pathetic communication of June 20th. Because of the hundred and more letters before me that claim response I was about to make very short work of yours before I had read half of it. However, I put it aside. Today, though the situation is not improved, I feel I must give you a few words. If you were a faithful "child of the Church", you would escape the danger of many of those problems of which you lament, viz, problems about God, science and religion. I must be brief. First let me lament your failure - with your so-called science - you fail to recognize as a science, the greatest science itself of all times and of all places, viz, the science of our happy dependence as rational creatures, on God and our neighbor. That is RELIGIOS; the only science that in the end - amounts to more than the snap of one's finger. Like every other science, though there be a thousand systems (denominations) there can be but one such science. It might be defined also; "The science of saving our souls or simply: "the science of charity", whose primary purpose is to foster what is sometimes called "the triune virtue of faith-hope- charity". Because they are essentially one virtue, the positive contrast on first glance of "Atheism-despair-hate" of which your first two sentences seem so positively to lament, viz, someone's own agnosticism, hatred and consequent, worse than disturbance. I was going to say above, that practi- cal Catholics know without a doubt what to believe concerning the referred- to problems. Besides; the more anyone of good will knows about true religion viz, the system of divine and infallible religion - the infallible system of religion - established and founded by Jesus Christ and proclaimed by His Twelve Apostles - watering it with their blood in imitation of Jesus their divine Master; so much the clearer does the whole Christian system unfold before the eye of common sense, and of the highest reasoning, as well as in the light of divine faith - all true sources of science and all phases of true religion the crown and final purpose of all.
